children: , the AI chipmaker, will supply the computing platform and AI tools behind Einride's push to put more driverless trucks on the road. Shares moves lower to $224.80 at roughly 10:50 a.m. ET Friday. The deal gives Nvidia another route into physical AI, though its financial payoff is still unclear.

Einride expects demand for 1,500 to 2,000 vehicles by 2028 and says about 80% of that demand could suit automation. It already has hundreds of electric trucks operating. This is more than a lab demonstration: Einride and Lidl have put a cabless Level 4 truck into regular service on public roads in Germany, Reuters reported, under a permit from the country's motor transport authority.

Nvidia's GF Score stands at 96 out of 100, with profitability, growth and financial strength looking particularly strong; GF Value is the clear weak spot. That matters here. Einride's vehicle forecast is not an Nvidia sales forecast. Neither company has said how much Nvidia technology each truck will carry or when the partnership might produce meaningful revenue. The test is how many trucks enter serviceand how much Nvidia earns from each one.

title: Nvidia Stock Moves Lower as Einride Scales Physical AI
